dedupe_keys.name: estimation of global tropical cyclone wind speed probabilities using the storm dataset

description: Estimation of global tropical cyclone wind speed probabilities using the STORM dataset is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Nadia Bloemendaal et al. Tropical cyclones (TC) are one of the deadliest and costliest natural disasters. To mitigate the impact of such disasters, researchers estimate extreme exceedance probabilities, also known as return periods, of TC hazards. Coverage: global; published in 2020. Formats: Excel. The data are held in 4TU.ResearchData and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
